notes.title: Formal Release Announcement
notes.content:
[h1]To all the supporters and fans of Neverinth,[/h1] 

I’m Alex, the producer at CreAct Games, the developer of Neverinth. First, I want to sincerely thank you for your support of Neverinth during Early Access. It's been an incredible journey and working with the community, your suggestions while continuously modifying and building the game has been incredibly rewarding. As you know, the game is still far from perfect and while we are proud of what we accomplished, we had hoped to create a much larger and more complete game. 

The sad truth is that although we want to continue development, we are out of money and sales are not high enough to support ongoing development. To make matters worse, one of my family members was recently diagnosed with blood cancer. The treatment of this disease is a long-term crisis for my family. As well as the huge expense, he also needs continuous company and support. Game development is my life, my career, and I would do almost anything to keep going but family is always the priority and  I owe it to myself and my team to end this project so we can all move on. 

At first, I tried to make it work rushing between the office and hospital, but it just didn’t work, I was unable to work effectively and felt town between my responsibility to my family and my team. In good conscience, I can only choose to cease development of Neverinth.  It’s a truly painful decision. 

I must apologize to partners and players who supported us during this time but for the sake of my team, my family, and myself, I made the best decision. I also think that being open and honest with the community of fans important and it would have been wrong to leave Neverinth in a Limbo state.  

For this reason Neverinth is leaving Early Access  today and this will be the last major update for Neverinth, while it’s not the game we envisioned, we are incredibly proud of it and we hope you enjoy it, rough edges and all! 

Thank you for your support and I wish each and every one of you safety and happiness during this global pandemic. Be safe, be kind, and cherish those close to you. 



[b]Below are the final update notes:[/b]
[olist] 
[*]Add：The Character’s max level increase to LV. 150 
[*]Added：New Boss - Salamander  
[*]Add：5 Ultimate equipments 
[*]Add：Achievement unlock- Level mode: Boss Rush  
[*]Add：New Boss-Salamander 
[*]Add：Buff status UI  
[*]Add：Make every rune’s icon design more unique 
[*]Add：Humanly Sound effect of mobs and Cultist Mentor 
[*]Add：Character’s permanent level stats UI 
[*]Modification：Permanent level’s required EXP value 
[*]Modification：Add "Unequip Totem" function in Totem system  
[/olist] 

 

[b]Adjustment of Rune ability[/b]
[u]Health[/u] 
[list] 
[*]Hale and Hearty：Increase physical damage by 1 for every 100 -> 200 max. health 
[*]Overflowing with Life：Increase stamina by 2 for every 100 -> 150 max. health 
[/list] 



Thank you, 
Alex

notes.title: New Boss & New Level (0.3.15) Patch Notes
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=eULNqQGEob8;full][/previewyoutube]
First, we must apologize for such a long waiting! For the last few months the whole CreAct dev team has gone through a series of difficulties and accidents; we sometime even doubt that are we will be able to continue the development or not….

But somehow, we made it, and are overjoyed to bring this big update for you guys! In this update we’ve implemented a huge change on the overall gameplay to fix issues since the first EA launch. Finally, we really hope that everyone can enjoy this content update, no matter you are old player or newcomer. Thank for all your patience!

[list]
[*] Add：New Level-Depth of Helheim
[*] Add: New boss-Ganglot
[*] Add: Eternal upgrade system
[*] Add: 7 Ultimate equipments
[*] Add：Achievement unlock- Totem slot +1

notes.title: (0.2.32) Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello there~ We now support Steam cloud save! We’ve also adjusted the Lock-on system for better control and gameplay. We hope the game is more comfortable to play. 

[olist]
[*]Add：Steam cloud save

[*]Adjust：Lock-on and swap system

[*]Adjust：Scroll the mouse wheel to swap locked-on target when using mouse 

[*]Adjust：AI improvements for Raven 

[*]Bug fix：If you are idle for a long time without any movement, character might become stuck in the wall or fall from/through scene and get a black/gray screen.

[*]Bug fix：Hit box adjustment for Cultist Mentor 
[*]Bug fix：If you run out of stamina and press the dodge button continuously, you might not be able to dodge even if stamina recovers again. 
[*]Bug fix：Use Alchemist's Ring to duplicate items
[*]Bug fix：After being hit, sometimes can’t dodge while moving. 
[*]Bug fix：No response when loading levels. Then, restart the game and get a grey screen. 
[/olist]

notes.title: (0.2.16) Bug emergency solution
notes.content:
We've received a few bugs report from enthusiastic players, and found where the problem is. Here is a temporary solution.

[h1] If you encountered the problems as follows:[/h1]
1.Black screen when entering the game
2.Falling from/through  scene
3.Can't turn the camera


[h1]Please try the following steps[/h1]
1.Open UI / Menu / System

2.Press select [Default ] -> [Apply] on [b]all tabs [/b] 
(especially on 'Camera' and 'Control Setting' tabs)

3.Leave the game

4.Start the game / Choose [New Round ]
(Attention! This will reset your system setting to default.)



Thanks for all your patience and support. We will work on a permanent fix ASAP.

notes.title: Road Map Update
notes.content:
Greetings one and all! 

Since launch we’ve been reading your feedback and formulating our plans for the future of Neverinth and we are very pleased to share our roadmap for the next few months of Early Access. You may notice that we haven’t added specific dates and that’s because we do not want to disappoint you with incorrect deadlines and are aware that some things may need to change due to the nature of Early Access. 

Rest assured that we are listening, and we are looking forward to making Neverinth better!  

Update One 
[list]
[*] New rooms for first level and adjustments of gameplay and system values. 
[/list]

Update Two 
[list]
[*] New special room type 
[*] New rooms for level two 
[*] New items and jewelry 
[*] Add teleport points within the levels 
[*] Add new skill to the “Cultist Mentor” 
[/list]

Update Three 
[list]
[*] Shiny new character!  
[*] New weapon Type! 
[/list]

Update Four 
[list]
[*] Third Level!
[/list] 

[list]
[*] New totem 
[*] New Outfit for all characters! 
[/list]
 
As well as major updates we have some other things that we are working on and will be getting to you ASAP: 

[list]
[*] VSync switch 
[*] General performance and optimization improvements 
[*] Automatic support for PS4 controller 
[*] BGM volume control 
[*] Sound Effect control 
[*] Customized control settings 
[*] Motion blur switch 
[/list]

Thanks for your time and your patience and you can always find us in the following places

notes.title: A Quick Thank You and a small update
notes.content:
THANK YOU ALL SO MUCH! 

The welcome we've received on Steam has been overwhelming and we are thrilled so many of you have dived into the Neverinth with such glee. We wanted to drop a quick note and say thanks for playing and thanks for all the feedback! We've received [b]a lot[/b] of feedback from the Steam Forums, Discord, and QQ groups and hope it continues.

All feedback is good feedback and we are dedicated to making Neverinth the best game we can. To that end we will be releasing an update very soon that will address many of the optimisation issues that have been mentioned and smooth out some elements of gameplay.

We are currently working on a more detailed roadmap and will update you soon!

notes.title: Revealing Neverinth, the untold story of a woman who became a Valkyrie and greater than Gods
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32940668/6a516cde79096cac25f7aec060f805ac073588c0.jpg[/img]

[h1]The gods are dead and the Tree of Life, Yggdrasill, puts its faith in you![/h1]

Another Indie is excited to announce Neverinth: The Never Ending Labyrinth, an action RPG hack'n slash with roguelike elements. Learn the stories of the Valkyries, the world's strongest women plucked from throughout time to protect realms of Midgard!

Along the journey, you will be immersed in the Norse Mythology and face bloody boss battles against the frightening creatures in the depth of the Old World. Inspired by the "Soulsborne" series, Neverinth embraces a combat system that is as punishing as it is rewarding.
[list]

[*] Play up to 5 different Valkyries, each with a unique set of abilities and history based on real historical figures.
[*] Gain the power of the fallen Gods unlocking their mythical weapons and skills.
[*] Unlock new content including levels, new characters, monsters, and abilities.
[*] Collect and wield a wide range of incredible weapons.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/966430/Neverinth/

[url=http://Discord.gg/ai][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32940668/3efaa3c1a6b86b68db66c123d8475b24b5c0e7af.png[/img][/url]
